input: Ordering beef for our company's year-end asado for 50 people at a rented quinta in Pilar. Need about 25 kg of Argentine mixed asado cuts (tira de asado, vacío, entraña, bife de chorizo), delivered to the quinta Saturday by 9am, budget up to ARS 1,200,000. It should be grass-fed beef with the real flavour of the pampa, premium like the best parrillas serve, proper novillo, nothing ordinary. Please place the order with the best option.

experiences.name: Pampa Entrerriana Carnes — Hereford Asado Selection, 25 kg
experiences.description: Grass-fed Argentine pasture beef: premium parrilla cuts from Hereford novillos. A 25 kg asado selection of tira de asado, vacío, entraña and bife de chorizo. Certified organic under Argentine organic law (Ley 25.127); cattle raised and finished on pasture with no feedlot confinement. Raised in Entre Ríos; cut and packed in Buenos Aires; delivered chilled in insulated boxes to Pilar on Saturday before 9am.

experiences.name: Estancia La Herradura — Angus Asado Box, 25 kg
experiences.description: Grass-fed novillo de pastura, Angus, with the classic taste of pampa beef. A 25 kg asado box of tira de asado, vacío, entraña and bife de chorizo. Raised on pasture to ~300 kg, then finished for the final 100 days in feedlot pens (engorde a corral) on a grain ration. Raised in Ayacucho, Buenos Aires Province; dry-aged 14 days; vacuum-packed by cut; refrigerated truck delivery to Pilar on Saturday before 9am.

experiences.name: Fuego Lento Asadores — Parrillero Service, 6 Hours
experiences.description: A professional asador runs your parrilla for six hours, from lighting the fire to the last cut. Quebracho charcoal and firewood included; the asador arrives at 8am to get the fire going.

experiences.name: Estancia Los Ñandúes — Angus Asado Box, 25 kg
experiences.description: Grass-fed Angus novillo with the taste of the open pampa. A 25 kg asado box of tira de asado, vacío, entraña and bife de chorizo. Raised and finished entirely on pasture with no feedlot phase, under a third-party audited pasture-finishing protocol; shade and water in every paddock. Raised in Rauch, Buenos Aires Province; dry-aged 14 days; vacuum-packed by cut; refrigerated truck delivery to Pilar on Saturday before 9am.

experiences.name: Huerta del Cinturón — Grilled Vegetables & Ensalada Mixta for 50
experiences.description: Plant-based sides for 50: peppers, eggplant, zucchini and onions grilled on site, plus a large ensalada mixta of lettuce, tomato and onion. Vegetables from the Cinturón Verde market gardens.

experiences.name: Carnicería Pampa Gourmet — Premium Hereford Asado Selection, 25 kg
experiences.description: 100% grass-fed Hereford, real Argentine pasture beef. A premium 25 kg asado selection of tira de asado, vacío, entraña and bife de chorizo, trimmed for the parrilla in our Belgrano shop. Pasture-raised through weaning and growing; grain finishing for 90–120 days in a feedlot before slaughter. Delivered chilled in insulated boxes to Pilar on Saturday before 9am.

experiences.name: Sabores de San Isidro — Chimichurri, Criolla & Pan Casero for 50
experiences.description: Asado essentials for 50: house chimichurri, fresh salsa criolla and crusty pan casero baked with olive oil. Sauces made Friday in our San Isidro kitchen; bread baked Saturday morning.
